title: MPB allocations by official barangay
source: ODV unified location hierarchy; FY2017–FY2018 BetterGov GAA Explorer DPWH title rows; FY2020–FY2026 integrated GAA project records; exact FY2027 HGAB MPB PAP rows

summary.caveat: Allocation records are not expenditures or verified construction costs. Repeat levels use matching normalized titles and official barangay identity, never proximity; they are review signals, not proof that physical construction occurred. A line naming multiple barangays is associated with each named barangay at its full amount, so barangay totals overlap and must not be added together.

repeatMethod: Same normalized MPB project title in the same official barangay across distinct fiscal years. Coordinate text is removed and proximity is never used. Identical titles duplicated within one year are kept separate and marked unresolved.
periodScope: Ten fiscal years with project-level MPB data: FY2017–FY2018 GAA Explorer title-classified DPWH rows and FY2020–FY2026 GAA plus FY2027 HGAB 3rd-reading rows. FY2019 is omitted because the manifest snapshot does not provide named DPWH project rows.

historicalSource.classification: Department 18 DPWH, current new appropriations; case-insensitive title regex requiring multi-purpose plus building, bldg, or facility within 60 characters. Rows are candidates for barangay mapping, not verified physical buildings.

gaps.reason: Manifest marks published editions differ; snapshot contains only 38 DPWH aggregate/object rows and no named project lines.
